text_block_list.text: Yes, we've completely run out of Ruhuna tea...

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Staff
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but I can prepare
some Ceylon tea for you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to drink her favorite tea,
Sirius Symboli found herself
in a foul mood...
